subject: Request: bridged remit + safeguards for Hydra Labs pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>; Alex Moreno <alex@hydralabs.com>
Date: 2026-09-08 09:15 PDT
Subject: Request: bridged remit + safeguards for Hydra Labs pilot

Team — looping you in on a request from Hydra Labs (early-stage genomics analytics) that would help them start a 6-month pilot. Key ask: they want a temporary invoice cadence that results in effective Net-90 for the first two invoices (customer procurement cycles).

Why: Hydra's procurement only processes on a quarterly basis and their PO system batches payments. They will sign, but collection is delayed ~60–90 days. If we push them to Net-30 they will walk.

My ask: Exec approval to allow a time-limited Net-90 / quarterly invoicing cadence for the pilot (covering first 2 quarters or up to $120k ARR), with the following mandatory mitigations: 
- Signed PO on file before kickoff (attachment: PO_template.pdf)
- Escrow-style milestone holdback: 15% hold until first renewal or completion of the pilot
- Usage cap & alerting: cap at X tokens / $ per month (we will pause overages)
- Customer agrees to DPA & SOC2 attestation (we will require evidence)
- Deferred-payment fee: 2% holding fee on invoices >60 days (applied only if delinquent)

Attachments: Hydra_LOI.pdf, SOW_v1.2.docx (draft).

Reasonable compromise vs. declining the pilot — we get logo & product feedback, Hydra commits to a paid pilot and conversion conversation at month 5.

Please advise if we can route this via deal desk with these constraints, or if legal/finance need additional items. Alex — appreciate a quick confirmation that PO & LOI can be executed this week if we can get approval.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

If finance (Grace) and legal (Jonas) are OK with the mitigations below then I support it for a six-month pilot limited to the stated $120k ARR cap.

Ben / Marissa — reviewed draft SOW and LOI. Legal is comfortable with a time-limited Net-90 so long as we add the following redlines (high-level):
- Explicit escrow/holdback clause (15%) with defined release triggers (pilot acceptance criteria or renewal signature).
- Payment default remedies and a limited interest/holding fee (2%) for invoices outstanding >60 days.
- Insert a procurement-PO acknowledgement section requiring Hydra to provide PO number within 7 days of DocuSign execution; failure to provide PO moves account to Net-30 billing on our side (customer-facing enforcement).
- Add an audit and SOC2/DPA evidence requirement within 14 days of execution.

I've attached Legal_redline_Hydra.docx (redline). Once the PO template is populated and LOI signed, I can finalize a short amendment to the Master Services Agreement to capture the timeline.

Date: 2026-09-10 14:02 PDT
Subject: Approval: conditional Net-90 for Hydra Labs pilot

Ben / Marissa / Jonas — I reviewed the ask and the proposed mitigations. Finance conditionally approves a temporary billing cadence that results in Net-90 for the first two invoices under the following conditions (must be satisfied before first invoice):
1) DocuSign execution of LOI + SOW with the redline language Jonas provided.
2) Signed PO from Hydra on file (we will not start provisioning without this).
3) 15% escrow holdback retained on invoices until either (a) completion of the pilot acceptance criteria or (b) signed renewal converting to standard terms. Escrow mechanics documented in amendment.
4) Hydra provides SOC2 report or equivalent within 14 days and names a finance contact.
5) Deferred-payment fee of 2% applies to invoices unpaid >60 days, collected at invoice settlement.
6) Limit: pilot total billings capped at $120,000 ARR equivalent for the trial period; exceptions require CFO sign-off.

Once the above are in place, deal desk may approve the special terms and Ops should configure the usage cap and automated pause. Please route the signed LOI + PO to finance@redwood.com and attach the HubSpot deal ID (DEAL-1197-HYD).

Grace O'Connor
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
